literal: Herself even if pacified she gets angry, to others also you of this nature become saying.
translation: Even when I try to pacify her, she gets angry, saying, "You must be acting this sweet to other women too!"
modern: நான் அவளை சமாதானப்படுத்த முயன்றாலும், நீங்கள் மற்ற பெண்களிடமும் இப்படித்தான் அன்பாக நடந்துகொள்வீர்கள் என்று கூறி அவள் என்மீது கோபப்படுவாள்.
explanation: The husband laments the subtle and inescapable nature of his wife's feigned anger. When he tries to comfort and pacify her, instead of calming down, she finds a new reason to be upset. She accuses him of being just as sweet and comforting to other women, turning his very act of affection into a cause for jealousy. Thus, every attempt to end the sulking only fuels it further.
